posts.title: Introduction to SeaBIOS
posts.description: SeaBIOS is an open-source implementation of a 16-bit x86 BIOS. The name is a pun: it is a BIOS written in C (instead of the traditional assembly). It is the firmware that QEMU and KVM run by default, and it is the payload coreboot uses when the next piece of software still expects a classic PC BIOS rather than UEFI.
